Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.ext

Class ExtensionBroker

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.ext.ExtensionBroker
public final class ExtensionBroker extends Object
The runtime that drives TextEditorExtension hooks on behalf of the editor panel. It is the single place that (a) asks the ExtensionRegistry which extensions are enabled, (b) enforces the granted-permission gate per hook, and (c) isolates failures so a throwing extension is logged and skipped without disturbing the editor or the other extensions.

All hooks are called on the EDT. The broker itself is stateless and thread-agnostic.
